2bf69095985e.en: The Missa solemnis is one of Beethoven’s most personal works – a passionate affirmation of faith and humanity. It draws on the traditions of sacred music, yet, in its monumental conception, reaches far beyond them. Beethoven gives musical expression to the liturgical text, from the dramatic Kyrie to the final, urgent plea for peace.
2bf69095985e.fr: La Missa solemnis est l’une des œuvres les plus personnelles de Beethoven – une affirmation passionnée de la foi et de l’humanité. Il s’inspire des traditions de la musique sacrée mais, dans sa conception monumentale, les dépasse largement. Beethoven donne une expression musicale au texte liturgique, du Kyrie dramatique à l'appel final et urgent pour la paix.
2bf69095985e.src: The Missa solemnis is one of Beethoven’s most personal works – a passionate affirmation of faith and humanity. It draws on the traditions of sacred music, yet, in its monumental conception, reaches far beyond them. Beethoven gives musical expression to the liturgical text, from the dramatic Kyrie to the final, urgent plea for peace.

2c1d3031f235.en: Wheelchair users please use the appropriate ticket. Most venues are barrier-free accessible. Severely disabled people who are entitled to a free companion show us their B pass at the entrance and can then take the companion with them without a ticket.
2c1d3031f235.fr: Les utilisateurs de fauteuils roulants doivent utiliser le ticket approprié. La plupart des sites sont accessibles sans obstacle. Les personnes gravement handicapées qui ont droit à un accompagnateur gratuit nous présentent leur pass B à l'entrée et peuvent ensuite emmener l'accompagnateur avec elles sans ticket.
2c1d3031f235.src: Rollstuhlnutzende bitte das entsprechende Ticket nutzen. Die meisten Venues sind barrierefrei zugänglich. Schwerbehinderte mit Anspruch auf eine kostenlose Begleitung zeigen uns am Eingang den B-Ausweis und können dann die Begleitperson ohne Ticket mitnehmen.

2db27e2179c9.en: Michael Wollny has long been one of the most adventurous figures on the European jazz scene. In this programme, the pianist revisits four of his musical projects, each exploring different styles, collaborations and sound worlds. In his solo Winterreise , he reimagines Schubert’s famous song cycle as darkly Romantic jazz improvisations.
2db27e2179c9.fr: Michael Wollny est depuis longtemps l’une des figures les plus aventureuses de la scène jazz européenne. Dans ce programme, le pianiste revisite quatre de ses projets musicaux, explorant chacun des styles, des collaborations et des univers sonores différents. Dans son solo Winterreise, il réinvente le célèbre cycle de chansons de Schubert sous forme d’improvisations jazz sombrement romantiques.
2db27e2179c9.src: Michael Wollny has long been one of the most adventurous figures on the European jazz scene. In this programme, the pianist revisits four of his musical projects, each exploring different styles, collaborations and sound worlds. In his solo Winterreise , he reimagines Schubert’s famous song cycle as darkly Romantic jazz improvisations.

2e7201bd4c89.en: The world is in turmoil. Not only are the harbingers of the French Revolution shaking society with class struggles and violence, but the family order of the old Earl of Moor is also threatening to collapse. Franz, the second-born son, feels cheated of his father's favor and wants revenge. He devises a plot against his older, favored brother Karl, who is then disowned by his father. Hurt by his father's rejection, Karl joins a band of robbers to fight against injustice in society.
2e7201bd4c89.fr: Le monde est en ébullition. Non seulement les précurseurs de la Révolution française ébranlent la société avec des luttes de classes et de la violence, mais l’ordre familial du vieux comte de Moor menace également de s’effondrer. Franz, le deuxième fils, se sent trompé par la faveur de son père et veut se venger. Il conçoit un complot contre son frère aîné et préféré Karl, qui est ensuite désavoué par son père. Blessé par le rejet de son père, Karl rejoint une bande de voleurs pour lutter contre l'injustice de la société.
2e7201bd4c89.src: The world is in turmoil. Not only are the harbingers of the French Revolution shaking society with class struggles and violence, but the family order of the old Earl of Moor is also threatening to collapse. Franz, the second-born son, feels cheated of his father's favor and wants revenge. He devises a plot against his older, favored brother Karl, who is then disowned by his father. Hurt by his father's rejection, Karl joins a band of robbers to fight against injustice in society.

307bd30ca065.en: It was his first great success, in a sense, his breakthrough: Nabucco. Premiered at Milan’s Scala in the spring of 1842, this work marks the start of the brilliant career of Giuseppe Verdi, who would become the leading Italian opera composer, going virtually unrivalled for decades.
307bd30ca065.fr: Ce fut son premier grand succès, en un sens, sa percée : Nabucco. Créée à la Scala de Milan au printemps 1842, cette œuvre marque le début de la brillante carrière de Giuseppe Verdi, qui deviendra le premier compositeur d'opéra italien, sans égal pendant des décennies.
307bd30ca065.src: It was his first great success, in a sense, his breakthrough: Nabucco. Premiered at Milan’s Scala in the spring of 1842, this work marks the start of the brilliant career of Giuseppe Verdi, who would become the leading Italian opera composer, going virtually unrivalled for decades.

309d28d5dc48.en: Girls Under Glass were founded in Hamburg in 1986 - at a time of profound socio-political upheaval, but beyond clearly defined musical scenes. While Gothic and Dark Wave increasingly developed stylistic conventions at the end of the 1980s, the band pursued an independent approach from the start: dark, experimental, emotional - but without genre clichés.
309d28d5dc48.fr: Girls Under Glass a été fondée à Hambourg en 1986, à une époque de profonds bouleversements sociopolitiques, mais au-delà des scènes musicales clairement définies. Alors que Gothic et Dark Wave développaient de plus en plus de conventions stylistiques à la fin des années 1980, le groupe poursuivit dès le départ une approche indépendante : sombre, expérimentale, émotionnelle - mais sans clichés de genre.
309d28d5dc48.src: Girls Under Glass wurden 1986 in Hamburg gegründet – in einer Zeit tiefgreifender gesellschaftspolitischer Umbrüche, aber jenseits klar definierter musikalischer Szenen. Während Gothic und Dark Wave Ende der 1980er zunehmend stilistische Konventionen entwickelten, verfolgte die Band von Beginn an einen eigenständigen Ansatz: dunkel, experimentell, emotional – aber ohne Genreklischees.

3107b2a74261.en: MAMI tells of mothers, of closeness and separation, of what is passed on. In a wordless, ritual visual theatre, Mario Banushi shapes personal memory into an intense experience between birth, desire and loss.
3107b2a74261.fr: MAMI parle des mères, de la proximité et de la séparation, de ce qui est transmis. Dans un théâtre visuel rituel sans mots, Mario Banushi transforme la mémoire personnelle en une expérience intense entre la naissance, le désir et la perte.
3107b2a74261.src: MAMI tells of mothers, of closeness and separation, of what is passed on. In a wordless, ritual visual theatre, Mario Banushi shapes personal memory into an intense experience between birth, desire and loss.

31c5eacd9ba8.en: IDA THE YOUNG is an indie folk/alt rock band from the Czech Republic. Some time ago our lead singer Iris moved to Pilsen and met our guitarist Marek. They decided to start making music together and were gradually joined by their mutual friends Pavel, Jakub and Filip (aka Slajmr Slajm). We like to play around with different textures and genres, initially leaning into the more folky side of things and eventually starting to explore electricity.
31c5eacd9ba8.fr: Ida the Young est un groupe de folk/alt rock indépendant originaire de République tchèque. Il y a quelque temps, notre chanteuse Iris a déménagé à Pilsen et a rencontré notre guitariste Marek. Ils décident de commencer à faire de la musique ensemble et sont progressivement rejoints par leurs amis communs Pavel, Jakub et Filip (alias Slajmr Slajm). Nous aimons jouer avec différentes textures et genres, en nous penchant d’abord vers le côté plus folk des choses et finalement en commençant à explorer l’électricité.
31c5eacd9ba8.src: IDA THE YOUNG is an indie folk/alt rock band from the Czech Republic. Some time ago our lead singer Iris moved to Pilsen and met our guitarist Marek. They decided to start making music together and were gradually joined by their mutual friends Pavel, Jakub and Filip (aka Slajmr Slajm). We like to play around with different textures and genres, initially leaning into the more folky side of things and eventually starting to explore electricity.

33bbcd99c6e3.en: The multi-award-winning ballet Nureyev, choreographed by Yuri Possokhov, composed by Ilya Demutsky and staged by visionary director Kirill Serebrennikov, premiered in December 2017 at Moscow’s world-famous Bolshoi Theatre. Even before its debut, the work caused a stir internationally. In its 25/26 season, the Staatsballett Berlin brought this extraordinary production to the stage for the first time outside Russia.
33bbcd99c6e3.fr: Le ballet primé à plusieurs reprises Nureyev, chorégraphié par Yuri Possokhov, composé par Ilya Demutsky et mis en scène par le metteur en scène visionnaire Kirill Serebrennikov, a été créé en décembre 2017 au célèbre Théâtre Bolchoï de Moscou. Avant même ses débuts, l’œuvre a fait sensation à l’échelle internationale. Au cours de sa saison 25/26, le Staatsballett Berlin a présenté pour la première fois cette production extraordinaire sur scène en dehors de la Russie.
33bbcd99c6e3.src: The multi-award-winning ballet Nureyev, choreographed by Yuri Possokhov, composed by Ilya Demutsky and staged by visionary director Kirill Serebrennikov, premiered in December 2017 at Moscow’s world-famous Bolshoi Theatre. Even before its debut, the work caused a stir internationally. In its 25/26 season, the Staatsballett Berlin brought this extraordinary production to the stage for the first time outside Russia.

33d4e51bdfec.en: Starting point of Shilpa Gupta’s solo exhibition at Hamburger Bahnhof is the monumental work TRUTH , situated at the intersection of language, power, and control. As visitors move through the oversized letters within the exhibition space, the artwork questions the mechanisms that preserve or obscure truth. The sculptural installation reveals how collective progress depends on protecting and interrogating truth.
33d4e51bdfec.fr: Le point de départ de l’exposition personnelle de Shilpa Gupta à la Hamburger Bahnhof est l’œuvre monumentale VÉRITÉ, située à l’intersection du langage, du pouvoir et du contrôle. Alors que les visiteurs se déplacent à travers les lettres surdimensionnées dans l’espace d’exposition, l’œuvre s’interroge sur les mécanismes qui préservent ou obscurcissent la vérité. L'installation sculpturale révèle à quel point le progrès collectif dépend de la protection et de l'interrogation de la vérité.
33d4e51bdfec.src: Starting point of Shilpa Gupta’s solo exhibition at Hamburger Bahnhof is the monumental work TRUTH , situated at the intersection of language, power, and control. As visitors move through the oversized letters within the exhibition space, the artwork questions the mechanisms that preserve or obscure truth. The sculptural installation reveals how collective progress depends on protecting and interrogating truth.

3479a28e35b0.en: “Fiddler! One Night Only!” is a new version of the 2023 show “Fiddler! A Musical” , focusing on music in a conversational setting. Subversive and funny, minimalist and poppy, Jewish and universal, it draws a line from folk traditions of the past into a strange, and hopefully better, future.
3479a28e35b0.fr: "Fiddler! One Night Only!" est une nouvelle version du spectacle 2023 « Fiddler! A Musical », axée sur la musique dans un cadre conversationnel. Subversif et drôle, minimaliste et pop, juif et universel, il trace une ligne entre les traditions folkloriques du passé et un avenir étrange et, espérons-le, meilleur.
3479a28e35b0.src: “Fiddler! One Night Only!” is a new version of the 2023 show “Fiddler! A Musical” , focusing on music in a conversational setting. Subversive and funny, minimalist and poppy, Jewish and universal, it draws a line from folk traditions of the past into a strange, and hopefully better, future.

3546ca5361da.en: New York-based artist Barnett Cohen comes to Sophiensæle for the first time. In their works, Cohen combines text-based scores and choreography into a total work of art. By weaving original writing with found language from text messages, dating apps, speculative fiction, queer theory, and poetry, splintering linear time, gender, and sexuality into elusive forms, figureless existences, and subversive calls to action.
3546ca5361da.fr: L'artiste new-yorkais Barnett Cohen vient à Sophiensæle pour la première fois. Dans leurs œuvres, Cohen combine des partitions textuelles et une chorégraphie en une œuvre d'art totale. En tissant une écriture originale avec un langage trouvé à partir de messages texte, d'applications de rencontres, de fiction spéculative, de théorie queer et de poésie, divisant le temps linéaire, le genre et la sexualité en formes insaisissables, existences sans figure et appels à l'action subversifs.
3546ca5361da.src: New York-based artist Barnett Cohen comes to Sophiensæle for the first time. In their works, Cohen combines text-based scores and choreography into a total work of art. By weaving original writing with found language from text messages, dating apps, speculative fiction, queer theory, and poetry, splintering linear time, gender, and sexuality into elusive forms, figureless existences, and subversive calls to action.

3639106e9aab.en: Her life reads like a crime novel made up of many lives: Königsberg in the 1910s, her student years with Heidegger and Jaspers, Berlin in the 1920s, Paris in the 1930s, escapes and friendships, New York in the 1950s and 1960s. The wars and totalitarian regimes of the 20th century shaped and preoccupied her. Her main political work, The Origins of Totalitarianism , made her famous overnight in 1951.
3639106e9aab.fr: Sa vie se lit comme un roman policier composé de plusieurs vies : Königsberg dans les années 1910, ses années d'études chez Heidegger et Jaspers, Berlin dans les années 1920, Paris dans les années 1930, les évasions et les amitiés, New York dans les années 1950 et 1960. Les guerres et les régimes totalitaires du XXe siècle l’ont façonnée et préoccupée. Son principal ouvrage politique, Les Origines du totalitarisme, la rendit célèbre du jour au lendemain en 1951.
3639106e9aab.src: Her life reads like a crime novel made up of many lives: Königsberg in the 1910s, her student years with Heidegger and Jaspers, Berlin in the 1920s, Paris in the 1930s, escapes and friendships, New York in the 1950s and 1960s. The wars and totalitarian regimes of the 20th century shaped and preoccupied her. Her main political work, The Origins of Totalitarianism , made her famous overnight in 1951.

374aa7fe1bfa.en: Oscar Wilde’s drama about the biblical princess who has the prophet Jochanaan beheaded so she can kiss his dead mouth unfolds a tableau of human depravity: From murder and necrophilia to sexualised violence, one shocking moment follows another. But it was not only these themes that made Strauss’s Salome a scandal, but also its radically modern, overwhelming music, which was far ahead of its time.
374aa7fe1bfa.fr: Le drame d'Oscar Wilde sur la princesse biblique qui fait décapiter le prophète Jochanaan afin qu'elle puisse embrasser sa bouche morte dévoile un tableau de dépravation humaine : du meurtre et de la nécrophilie à la violence sexualisée, un moment choquant suit un autre. Mais ce ne sont pas seulement ces thèmes qui ont fait de Salome de Strauss un scandale, mais aussi sa musique radicalement moderne et bouleversante, très en avance sur son temps.
374aa7fe1bfa.src: Oscar Wilde’s drama about the biblical princess who has the prophet Jochanaan beheaded so she can kiss his dead mouth unfolds a tableau of human depravity: From murder and necrophilia to sexualised violence, one shocking moment follows another. But it was not only these themes that made Strauss’s Salome a scandal, but also its radically modern, overwhelming music, which was far ahead of its time.

3824705c749b.en: The exhibition The International Abstraction at the Neue Nationalgalerie looks back on the politically turbulent era in art after 1945. The project marks the 50th anniversary of the FREUNDE der Nationalgalerie and, in its scope, goes far beyond the defining Western movements to highlight the global diversity of abstract art.
3824705c749b.fr: L'exposition The International Abstraction à la Neue Nationalgalerie revient sur la période politiquement turbulente de l'art après 1945. Le projet marque le 50e anniversaire de la FREUNDE der Nationalgalerie et, dans sa portée, va bien au-delà des mouvements occidentaux déterminants pour mettre en lumière la diversité mondiale de l'art abstrait.
3824705c749b.src: The exhibition The International Abstraction at the Neue Nationalgalerie looks back on the politically turbulent era in art after 1945. The project marks the 50th anniversary of the FREUNDE der Nationalgalerie and, in its scope, goes far beyond the defining Western movements to highlight the global diversity of abstract art.

38c358916d9f.en: TWINS IN COLOUR are three people who found each other in 2025 in Leipzig/Germany to create a particular sound of dark/psych/synth pop. Over layers of synthesizers, noises, guitars and reverb-soaked vocals they tell stories of the moon, the ocean floor and all the other things that live within us. — n0t herethere is a Berlin-based independent artist making dark electronic music, trip-hop and experimental pop.
38c358916d9f.fr: Twins in Colour, ce sont trois personnes qui se sont rencontrées en 2025 à Leipzig, en Allemagne, pour créer un son particulier de dark/psych/synth pop. Sur des couches de synthétiseurs, de bruits, de guitares et de voix imprégnées de réverbération, ils racontent des histoires sur la lune, les fonds marins et toutes les autres choses qui vivent en nous. — n0t herethere est un artiste indépendant basé à Berlin qui compose de la musique électronique sombre, du trip-hop et de la pop expérimentale.
38c358916d9f.src: TWINS IN COLOUR are three people who found each other in 2025 in Leipzig/Germany to create a particular sound of dark/psych/synth pop. Over layers of synthesizers, noises, guitars and reverb-soaked vocals they tell stories of the moon, the ocean floor and all the other things that live within us. — n0t herethere is a Berlin-based independent artist making dark electronic music, trip-hop and experimental pop.

3924ac4bafa5.en: Whether written for eight, nine or ten players, chamber music for wind instruments on this scale is an experience for the audience and performers alike. It opens up a rare sound world, rich in instrumental colour, at times almost orchestral, at others intimate and conversational. This is true of Beethoven’s festive Octet in E-flat major, Gustav Schreck’s Romantic Nonet and George Enescu’s richly textured Decet alike.
3924ac4bafa5.fr: Qu'elle soit écrite pour huit, neuf ou dix musiciens, la musique de chambre pour instruments à vent de cette envergure est une expérience aussi bien pour le public que pour les interprètes. Il ouvre un monde sonore rare, riche en couleurs instrumentales, tantôt presque orchestrales, tantôt intimes et conversationnelles. Cela est vrai aussi bien de l’Octuor festif en mi bémol majeur de Beethoven, que du Nonet romantique de Gustav Schreck et du Decet richement texturé de George Enescu.
3924ac4bafa5.src: Whether written for eight, nine or ten players, chamber music for wind instruments on this scale is an experience for the audience and performers alike. It opens up a rare sound world, rich in instrumental colour, at times almost orchestral, at others intimate and conversational. This is true of Beethoven’s festive Octet in E-flat major, Gustav Schreck’s Romantic Nonet and George Enescu’s richly textured Decet alike.

39494dae9dc9.en: Since the early 1990s, South Korean artist KOO JEONG A (b. 1967, KR) has worked with varied materials, from found objects to large-scale public installations, to create works that play with our perception and connect us to hidden forces that lie beyond the visible, asking us to consider how we allow our senses to inform our reading of a thing, a place, or a moment.
39494dae9dc9.fr: Depuis le début des années 1990, l'artiste sud-coréen KOO JEONG A (né en 1967, KR) travaille avec des matériaux variés, depuis des objets trouvés jusqu'à des installations publiques à grande échelle, pour créer des œuvres qui jouent avec notre perception et nous connectent à des forces cachées qui se trouvent au-delà du visible, nous demandant de réfléchir à la manière dont nous permettons à nos sens d'éclairer notre lecture d'une chose, d'un lieu ou d'un moment.
39494dae9dc9.src: Since the early 1990s, South Korean artist KOO JEONG A (b. 1967, KR) has worked with varied materials, from found objects to large-scale public installations, to create works that play with our perception and connect us to hidden forces that lie beyond the visible, asking us to consider how we allow our senses to inform our reading of a thing, a place, or a moment.

39645abb5bb2.en: Manon Lescaut enjoys the admiration of men who pine for her. Her brother pursues their father’s plan to protect her from the men in a convent. The affluent Geronte wants to entice her to his world, but she grants her love to the young Des Grieux and escapes the clutches of her brother. But briefly thereafter, she follows Geronte’s material enticements and becomes dependent on him. Nonetheless, her love for Des Grieux soon makes her want to abandon her new surroundings once again.
39645abb5bb2.fr: Manon Lescaut jouit de l'admiration des hommes qui la recherchent. Son frère poursuit le plan de leur père pour la protéger des hommes d'un couvent. L'aisée Geronte veut l'attirer dans son monde, mais elle accorde son amour au jeune Des Grieux et échappe aux griffes de son frère. Mais brièvement par la suite, elle suit les séductions matérielles de Geronte et devient dépendante de lui. Néanmoins, son amour pour Des Grieux lui donne bientôt envie d'abandonner à nouveau son nouvel environnement.
39645abb5bb2.src: Manon Lescaut enjoys the admiration of men who pine for her. Her brother pursues their father’s plan to protect her from the men in a convent. The affluent Geronte wants to entice her to his world, but she grants her love to the young Des Grieux and escapes the clutches of her brother. But briefly thereafter, she follows Geronte’s material enticements and becomes dependent on him. Nonetheless, her love for Des Grieux soon makes her want to abandon her new surroundings once again.

3b7b9c4dcec2.en: This concert brings the Berliner Philharmoniker Ensembles’ Beethoven series to a close with two of the composer’s most popular chamber works: the “Gassenhauer Trio”, with its ingenious variations on a popular operatic hit, and his Septet in E-flat major. Both works combine melodic invention with wit and elegance.
3b7b9c4dcec2.fr: Ce concert clôture la série Berliner Philharmoniker Ensembles’ Beethoven avec deux des œuvres de chambre les plus populaires du compositeur : le « Trio Gassenhauer », avec ses ingénieuses variations sur un succès d’opéra populaire, et son Septuor en mi bémol majeur. Les deux œuvres combinent invention mélodique avec esprit et élégance.
3b7b9c4dcec2.src: This concert brings the Berliner Philharmoniker Ensembles’ Beethoven series to a close with two of the composer’s most popular chamber works: the “Gassenhauer Trio”, with its ingenious variations on a popular operatic hit, and his Septet in E-flat major. Both works combine melodic invention with wit and elegance.

3d31149e7215.en: Berlin artist Susanne Kriemann (b. 1972, Germany) tracks remnants of the industrial era and the atomic age into our immediate environment. Her extensive engagement with radioactivity was initially motivated by the Chernobyl disaster of forty years ago, which remains a recurring motif in her artistic research. Now, this exhibition is centered around the landscapes of former uranium extraction sites in Saxony, Thuringia, and the Limousin region in France.
3d31149e7215.fr: L'artiste berlinois Susanne Kriemann (né en 1972, Allemagne) retrace les vestiges de l'ère industrielle et de l'ère atomique dans notre environnement immédiat. Son engagement approfondi dans le domaine de la radioactivité a été initialement motivé par la catastrophe de Tchernobyl survenu il y a quarante ans, qui reste un motif récurrent dans sa recherche artistique. Désormais, cette exposition est centrée sur les paysages d'anciens sites d'extraction d'uranium en Saxe, en Thuringe et dans la région du Limousin en France.
3d31149e7215.src: Berlin artist Susanne Kriemann (b. 1972, Germany) tracks remnants of the industrial era and the atomic age into our immediate environment. Her extensive engagement with radioactivity was initially motivated by the Chernobyl disaster of forty years ago, which remains a recurring motif in her artistic research. Now, this exhibition is centered around the landscapes of former uranium extraction sites in Saxony, Thuringia, and the Limousin region in France.

3d3179a9ac83.en: Barrie Kosky’s mystical and visually striking production sweeps the audience into the enigmatic world of fairy tales – and in doing so tells us more about our times than you’d think. Tsar Dodon is plagued by worries, with his kingdom threatened by enemies all around. He’d rather just eat and sleep instead of looking after his country. An astrologer enters the scene with just the right solution: a golden cockerel that crows and flaps if danger looms. Dodon is delighted!
3d3179a9ac83.fr: La mise en scène mystique et visuellement saisissante de Barrie Kosky entraîne le public dans le monde énigmatique des contes de fées – et, ce faisant, nous en dit plus sur notre époque qu'on ne le pense. Le tsar Dodon est rongé par les soucis, son royaume étant menacé par des ennemis de tous côtés. Il préférerait simplement manger et dormir plutôt que de s'occuper de son pays. Un astrologue entre en scène avec la solution idéale : un coq d'or qui chante et bat des ailes si le danger se profile. Dodon est ravi !
3d3179a9ac83.src: Barrie Kosky’s mystical and visually striking production sweeps the audience into the enigmatic world of fairy tales – and in doing so tells us more about our times than you’d think. Tsar Dodon is plagued by worries, with his kingdom threatened by enemies all around. He’d rather just eat and sleep instead of looking after his country. An astrologer enters the scene with just the right solution: a golden cockerel that crows and flaps if danger looms. Dodon is delighted!

3d5880369503.en: In the year marking the 200th anniversary of Beethoven’s death, Leif Ove Andsnes performs the composer’s final three piano sonatas. These remarkable works, the culmination of Beethoven’s writing for the piano, range from the luminous lyricism of the Sonata in E major, Op. 109, through the inward intensity of Op. 110 to the uncompromising vision of his final Piano Sonata, Op. 111.
3d5880369503.fr: L’année marquant le 200e anniversaire de la mort de Beethoven, Leif Ove Andsnes interprète les trois dernières sonates pour piano du compositeur. Ces œuvres remarquables, point culminant de l’écriture pour piano de Beethoven, vont du lyrisme lumineux de la Sonate en mi majeur op. 109, à travers l’intensité intérieure de l’op. 110 à la vision sans compromis de sa dernière Sonate pour piano, op. 111.
3d5880369503.src: In the year marking the 200th anniversary of Beethoven’s death, Leif Ove Andsnes performs the composer’s final three piano sonatas. These remarkable works, the culmination of Beethoven’s writing for the piano, range from the luminous lyricism of the Sonata in E major, Op. 109, through the inward intensity of Op. 110 to the uncompromising vision of his final Piano Sonata, Op. 111.

3d8c02bd67da.en: In 2019, author Caren Jeß published her dramatic compendium Bookpink , a collection of seven miniatures about human abysses, social structures, and societal debates, whose protagonists were birds. After the ATT Atelier 2024, the Bookpink universe continues to grow—Caren Jeß introduces the new arrivals in the bird world, which is all too similar to our own: full of power fantasies, fragile orders, and the strange disappearance of imagination.
3d8c02bd67da.fr: En 2019, l'auteure Caren Jeß a publié son recueil dramatique Bookpink, une collection de sept miniatures sur les abîmes humains, les structures sociales et les débats sociétaux, dont les protagonistes étaient les oiseaux. Après l'ATT Atelier 2024, l'univers Bookpink continue de s'agrandir : Caren Jeß présente les nouveaux venus dans le monde des oiseaux, qui ne ressemble que trop au nôtre : plein de fantasmes de pouvoir, d'ordres fragiles et d'étranges disparitions de l'imagination.
3d8c02bd67da.src: In 2019, author Caren Jeß published her dramatic compendium Bookpink , a collection of seven miniatures about human abysses, social structures, and societal debates, whose protagonists were birds. After the ATT Atelier 2024, the Bookpink universe continues to grow—Caren Jeß introduces the new arrivals in the bird world, which is all too similar to our own: full of power fantasies, fragile orders, and the strange disappearance of imagination.

3eeff27ea5e3.en: JOHNNY DYNAMITE is a Philadelphia based post-punk artist signed to Born Losers Records. Over the course of his first three albums, Johnny Dynamite has emerged as a succinct storyteller and songwriter. The characters inside Johnny’s dream world are lucid, manic, and brimming with pangs of nostalgia. Poised against dark and atmospheric instrumentals, his harrowed vocal delivery and lyrics paint a picture of lost youth, hopeless romanticism, and teenage rebellion.
3eeff27ea5e3.fr: Johnny Dynamite est un artiste post-punk basé à Philadelphie, signé chez Born Losers Records. Au fil de ses trois premiers albums, Johnny Dynamite s'est révélé être un conteur et un auteur-compositeur concis. Les personnages du monde onirique de Johnny sont lucides, maniaques et débordants de nostalgie. Contrastant avec des instrumentaux sombres et atmosphériques, son interprétation vocale tourmentée et ses paroles brossent un tableau de la jeunesse perdue, du romantisme désespéré et de la rébellion adolescente.
3eeff27ea5e3.src: JOHNNY DYNAMITE is a Philadelphia based post-punk artist signed to Born Losers Records. Over the course of his first three albums, Johnny Dynamite has emerged as a succinct storyteller and songwriter. The characters inside Johnny’s dream world are lucid, manic, and brimming with pangs of nostalgia. Poised against dark and atmospheric instrumentals, his harrowed vocal delivery and lyrics paint a picture of lost youth, hopeless romanticism, and teenage rebellion.

401f7739ccdf.en: Celebrate New Year’s Eve in Berlin with Kintsugi: Experience world-class acrobatics, culinary delights, loads of confetti and dance into the New Year in our historical ballroom. An unforgettable night awaits!
401f7739ccdf.fr: Célébrez le réveillon du Nouvel An à Berlin avec Kintsugi : faites l'expérience d'acrobaties de classe mondiale, de délices culinaires, de confettis et dansez le Nouvel An dans notre salle de bal historique. Une nuit inoubliable vous attend !
401f7739ccdf.src: Celebrate New Year’s Eve in Berlin with Kintsugi: Experience world-class acrobatics, culinary delights, loads of confetti and dance into the New Year in our historical ballroom. An unforgettable night awaits!

40a7e0f0d254.en: When Victor Hugo brought his play Le roi s’amuse to the stage for the first and last time in Paris in 1832, the performance ended with the immediate banning of the play. When the Italian Risorgimento composer Giuseppe Verdi decided to set the revolutionary French author’s play to music almost 20 years later, he faced resistance from the censorship authorities.
40a7e0f0d254.fr: Lorsque Victor Hugo apporta sa pièce Le roi s'amuse sur scène pour la première et la dernière fois à Paris en 1832, la représentation se termina par l'interdiction immédiate de la pièce. Lorsque le compositeur italien Giuseppe Verdi décide de mettre en musique la pièce de l'auteur révolutionnaire français près de 20 ans plus tard, il fait face à la résistance des autorités de censure.
40a7e0f0d254.src: When Victor Hugo brought his play Le roi s’amuse to the stage for the first and last time in Paris in 1832, the performance ended with the immediate banning of the play. When the Italian Risorgimento composer Giuseppe Verdi decided to set the revolutionary French author’s play to music almost 20 years later, he faced resistance from the censorship authorities.

424d386be2a3.en: It is perhaps the most famous dash in world literature: in the middle of a soberly narrated sentence about a surprise attack during wartime, Heinrich von Kleist's novella Die Marquise von O. (The Marquise of O.) reads: “—that she had, without knowing it, come into different circumstances.” An abrupt break—where the decisive moment should actually be. Instead of clarity: a blank space.
424d386be2a3.fr: C'est peut-être le tiret le plus célèbre de la littérature mondiale : au milieu d'une phrase racontée avec sobriété, évoquant une attaque surprise en temps de guerre, la nouvelle de Heinrich von Kleist, La Marquise d'O. (The Marquise of O.), dit : « — qu'elle s'était, sans le savoir, retrouvée dans une situation différente. » Une rupture abrupte – là où devrait se situer le moment décisif. Au lieu de la clarté : un espace vide.
424d386be2a3.src: It is perhaps the most famous dash in world literature: in the middle of a soberly narrated sentence about a surprise attack during wartime, Heinrich von Kleist's novella Die Marquise von O. (The Marquise of O.) reads: “—that she had, without knowing it, come into different circumstances.” An abrupt break—where the decisive moment should actually be. Instead of clarity: a blank space.

42511b171f7b.en: With Akhnaten , minimal-music pioneer Philip Glass created a monument to one of the most enigmatic figures in world history. In staging the story of the pharaoh’s rise and fall, Barrie Kosky offers us a vision rich in visuals and movement. Thebes, around 1300 BCE: Amenhotep III has died. His son, Amenhotep IV, who later takes the name Akhnaten, is crowned pharaoh.
42511b171f7b.fr: Avec Akhnaten, le pionnier de la musique minimaliste Philip Glass a créé un monument en l'honneur de l'une des figures les plus énigmatiques de l'histoire mondiale. En mettant en scène l'histoire de l'ascension et de la chute du pharaon, Barrie Kosky nous offre une vision riche en images et en mouvement. Thèbes, vers 1300 av. J.-C. : Amenhotep III est mort. Son fils, Amenhotep IV, qui prendra plus tard le nom d'Akhénaton, est couronné pharaon.
42511b171f7b.src: With Akhnaten , minimal-music pioneer Philip Glass created a monument to one of the most enigmatic figures in world history. In staging the story of the pharaoh’s rise and fall, Barrie Kosky offers us a vision rich in visuals and movement. Thebes, around 1300 BCE: Amenhotep III has died. His son, Amenhotep IV, who later takes the name Akhnaten, is crowned pharaoh.

42ed308f2d01.en: Raised in an environment lacking in moderation and inhibition, the eccentric Princess Salome is fascinated by the otherness of the ethical and ascetic Prophet Jochanaan, whom her mother Herodias and her lecherous stepfather Herod keep imprisoned. When Jochanaan brusquely rejects Salome’s lustful approaches, she becomes downright obsessed with him and uses her stepfather’s lustfulness to enforce her will.
42ed308f2d01.fr: Élevée dans un environnement dépourvu de modération et d'inhibition, l'excentrique princesse Salome est fascinée par l'altérité du prophète éthique et ascétique Jochanaan, que sa mère Hérodiade et son beau-père lubrique Hérode emprisonnent. Lorsque Jochanaan rejette brusquement les approches lubriques de Salome, elle devient carrément obsédée par lui et utilise la luxure de son beau-père pour faire respecter sa volonté.
42ed308f2d01.src: Raised in an environment lacking in moderation and inhibition, the eccentric Princess Salome is fascinated by the otherness of the ethical and ascetic Prophet Jochanaan, whom her mother Herodias and her lecherous stepfather Herod keep imprisoned. When Jochanaan brusquely rejects Salome’s lustful approaches, she becomes downright obsessed with him and uses her stepfather’s lustfulness to enforce her will.

4315dc0cf7f4.en: Almost completed, then interrupted: Dumb Type’s 2020 long remained a phantom work. Now it becomes reality. In a hybrid interplay of body, technology and sound, an image of our vulnerable, surveilled and over-informed world comes into focus. Artist Talk Saturday, 16.1.2027 after the performance Haus der Berliner Festspiele, Main Stage In Japanese with translation into English
4315dc0cf7f4.fr: Presque terminé, puis interrompu : le 2020 de Dumb Type est longtemps resté une œuvre fantôme. Maintenant, cela devient réalité. Dans un jeu hybride de corps, de technologie et de son, une image de notre monde vulnérable, surveillé et sur-informé apparaît. Artist Talk Samedi 16.1.2027 après la performance Haus der Berliner Festspiele, Main Stage En japonais avec traduction en anglais
